component.name: ARIB Caption Monitor
component.summary: Monitor Brazilian ARIB captions in MPEG-TS

description.p: Receives MPEG-TS over UDP (unicast, multicast or RTP) or plays .ts/.m2ts files and shows ARIB captions in the Brazilian standard (ABNT NBR 15606-1 / ISDB-Tb) the way a receiver does, together with video and audio.

ul.li: Panel with PAT, PMT, SDT, PIDs, bitrate and continuity errors
ARIB control codes of every caption and their position on screen
Automatic validation of the caption stream, with the source of each rule
Opens idle: choose UDP or a file in the window
